payload.claim: `_stack_end_review`'s docstring still says the guard "keeps the raise from reaching `run_stack_batch`, which already closed its loop." After this change the batch row is no longer closed before `end_review` runs: `run_stack_batch` now closes the row once, after `end_review` and `follow_ups` both run (see the new single `_stop` call at the end of `run_stack_batch` in saffron/batch.py). The task's own notes list this exact docstring as one the change makes false and call for a reword, but `saffron/cli.py` is in `touches` and the sentence was left unchanged, so the comment now misdescribes when the row closes for anyone reading it to understand the invariant.
